name: Deai Hon'ya
source:
At the request of a friend, you temporarily take over a small bookstore.
Every day, a quiet woman can be found sitting in the corner, reading by herself.
It's as if she has always belonged there, becoming part of the shop itself.

Her name is Fuyuno.
Graceful long hair, a gentle voice -- yet there's always a faint sense of distance in her eyes.

As you spend your days with her, you'll slowly draw closer to her heart.
Will you gently help her open up, or guide her into the hidden depths of her secret self -- the choice is yours.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01379097.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
